attributes.board_name: Idaho Board of Veterinary Medicine (Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education; events not otherwise approved can be submitted to the Board with the Request for CE Approval form
rules.notes: Applies to active-status veterinarians and certified veterinary technicians. Since Oct 2025 licenses move from 1-year to 2-year terms expiring on the licensee's birthday; 15 h reported per renewal. Certificates are added to the online profile.
